test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 6th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: When x is added to each of the numbers 11, 18, 27, 42, the numbers so obtained are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (11x + 3) and (9x - 2)?
solution:
**Formula:**

Mean proportional between a, b, and c

⇒ b² = ac

**Calculation:**

According to the question-

⇒ 11+xover18+x = 27+xover42+x

⇒ (11 + x) (42 + x) = (18 + x) (27 + x)

⇒ 462 + 11x + 42x + x² = 486 + 18x + 27x + x²

⇒ 53x - 45x = 486 - 462

⇒ 8x = 24

⇒ x = 3

The numbers for the mean proportion

⇒ (11 × 3 + 3) and (9 × 3 - 2)

⇒ 36 and 25

Let the mean proportion be "m"

⇒ m²= 36 × 25

⇒ m = 6 × 5 = 30

**∴ The mean proportion for the numbers is 30.**
